A - Inequality Problem

Time limit: 2 sec / Memory limit: 1024 MB

Problem Statement

First, for any value x where 1 ≤ x < 2M, we set A ← (A1 ⊕ x). This is an important condition.

You are given an integer N and a sequence A1, A2, and so on up to AN. Determine whether the condition above holds for every pair of indices i and j satisfying 1 ≤ i < j ≤ N. Print Yes if it does, and No otherwise.

Constraints

  • 1 ≤ N ≤ 3000
  • 0 ≤ Ai ≤ 109
